name: rnd-blog-series-planner
description: Technical blog series planning assistant. Use when users need to (1) Plan a technical blog series (技术专题规划), (2) Structure multiple interconnected articles with logical progression, (3) Design content roadmaps for tutorials or documentation, (4) Create publication schedules for technical content. Trigger keywords: 博客系列、专题规划、系列文章、文章规划、content series, blog series planning, tutorial series, article roadmap.
